content.content: 1. Necessity per prerequisite: command behavior needs kinds for verdict-freedom, separation for read-alone and resolution, validity for the machine-checkable definition, and coverage for covering every decision edge. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss; name the dropped edge. 2. License: no element contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Command behavior is where the CLI touches truth; the gate forces every check to answer to its prerequisite.
